{{Quote|To the Echani, battle is a means of communication - it is an art, in the truest sense of the word.|[[Brianna]], to [[Meetra Surik]]|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}
The '''Echani''' were a [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eshan/Legends|Eshan]]. The [[Sun Guard]] arose from the [[Thyrsian]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the Echani.

==Biology and appearance==
The Echani had similar anatomy to that of [[Human/Legends|humans]], but were physically distinct due to their light skin, white hair and silver eyes.<ref name="ROT" /> They exhibited among themselves a remarkable similarity to each other in their body type and facial features, with close family members such as siblings often appearing indistinguishable to an outside observer. The [[Thyrsian]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the Echani, in contrast, shared few of these traits, possessing dark hair and skin, rather than the white hair and silver eyes the Echani became known for.<ref name="GAW" />

It was believed that the Echani were a result of [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] experimentation with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] genome, a theory which could explain the resemblance among these members of the species.<ref name="GAW" />

Due to the all-encompassing use of combat in all levels of their culture, Echani Generals were seen by others as having the ability to predict their opponent's next move. This was not a biological trait inherent to the Echani or their subspecies. Instead, it arose from a culture where combat was seen as the truest form of communication.<ref name="KOTORII" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|It is the way of the Echani to be able to read their opponents - to know where an opponent is going to strike before it connects, anticipate it, and then strike against them. Echani battles are fought several minutes in advance.|Brianna, to Meetra Surik|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}
The Echani were a matriarchal caste-based society originating from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] world of [[Eshan/Legends|Eshan]] that spread to worlds such as [[Begali]] and [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] to encompass a [[confederacy]] of six worlds known as the [[Six Sisters]], governed by the all-female ruling council of the [[Echani Command]].<ref name="GAW" /><ref name="KOTORII" />

On the worlds known as the Six Sisters, the Echani developed a kinetic communication style and can instantly identify an individual through subtle shifts in body language. This sensitivity translates well to physical combat.<ref name="GAW" />

===Communication through combat===
{{Quote|Duels among the Echani are rituals, and do not allow for armor or anything that restricts movement.|Brianna|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}
[[File:Echanipractice.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Echani (martial art)/Legends|Echani martial art]] featured heavily in the training of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]]]]
Echani culture held the belief that to know one fully, you must fight them. [[Echani (martial art)/Legends|Echani fighting]] was not only self-defense, but a form of self-expression, a means of communication similar to art. During the [[Old Republic era]], [[Echani Firedancer]]s combined Echani fighting techniques with exotic weapons such as [[Echani Ritual Brand|ritual brands]], blending the two together in a manner akin to a dance. For the Echani, it was not at all unusual for children of the same parents to be born so as to be completely indistinguishable from one another to outsiders. Thus, being able to distinguish between like individuals through reading of body movement became an essential requirement.

The Echani were also known to be able to read feelings and emotion through combat. To an Echani, a combat between two people said more than hours of talking. They saw a certain purity in the way techniques were used in battle.<ref name="Conversatio">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'': Conversations with Brianna.</ref> The [[Maktite]]s learned this to their own sorrow circa [[3956 BBY]], when their stores of thermal weaponry were rendered ineffectual by relatively simple adjustments in the traditional Echani light armor.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

===Combat Gear===
{{Quote|Personal shields, I love you so.. crafting and fighting with you&hellip; exhilarates me. You are the MAIN focus of my life&hellip; (except for my melee weapons and armor)&hellip; I love you so.|An Echani Poem|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}
The Echani were known to focus on unarmed combat and melee weapons.<ref name="GAW" /><ref name="KOTOR" /> They were considered excellent craftsmen of these weapons, as common melee weapons throughout the galaxy before and during the [[Jedi Civil War]] such as [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]] were based on Echani designs. However, mass-produced Echani weapons such as the [[Echani foil|foils]] crafted in honor of [[Raskta Fenni]] rarely survived the crafting process due to difficulties in weaving them with [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]. Echani-made double-bladed [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] were used by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]], influencing their appearance. Though their personal energy [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] were popular during the period surrounding [[Meetra Surik]]'s travel through the galaxy, they gradually fell out of general use.

The Echani largely eschewed the use of heavy armor, preferring to fight in light armor, whilst they trained in minimal clothing. Their fighting style focused more on agility and movement, and so anything that hampered their freedom of movement would be avoided.<ref name="KOTORII" />

[[Ergeron]], a Mandalorian mercenary, was disgusted at the Echani and their relatively "light" weapons.

==History==
{{Quote|He was slain by Revan in the Jedi Civil War when Revan sought to destabilize the Echani worlds. Revan succeeded.|Brianna, about [[Yusanis]]|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}
The Echani were a culture of respected warriors, with Echani such as [[Raskta Fenni]], who lived years before the Jedi Civil War and was famous for being known as the best duelists of her time, and [[Raskta Lsu]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth's]] [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. Echani held a long-standing rivalry with the Mandalorians, which led to the Echani entering the [[Mandalorian Wars]] on the side of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Echani [[General/Legends|General]] [[Yusanis]] fought alongside the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Arren Kae]] in the conflict until the [[Battle of Malachor V]], which led to Yusanis returning from the war alone to become a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]. Following the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of an Echani Senator on the orders of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during the Jedi Civil War, Yusanis challenged Revan to a duel, and was defeated by the Sith. After the outbreak of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the Echani engaged in battle against Revan, and were defeated. As with the Mandalorians upon their defeat by Revan, the Echani respected the combat skill of their enemy.<ref name="KOTOR" />

By [[1154 BBY]], tensions between the ruling council of the [[Echani Command]] and the planets of Begali and Thyrsus led to a revolt, beginning the [[Begali Uprising]]. Though Begali would rejoin Echani Command less than a century after the uprising, The [[Thyrsian]]s led a string of crusades against the Echani Command until the independence of Thyrsus was recognized with the [[Pact of Almera]] in [[899 BBY]]. During this conflict, the [[Thyrsian special forces]] division evolved into the seminomadic mercenary group that became known as the [[Sun Guard]].<ref name="GAW" />

[[Echani (martial art)/Legends|Echani fighting techniques]] remained in use by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]<ref name="Crimson">[[Crimson Empire 1|''Crimson Empire'' 1]]</ref> and [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] by the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TEM">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> while double-bladed vibroblades of Echani design were used by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]].

==Notable Echani==
[[File:Handmaidenpromo.jpg|thumb|180px|[[Brianna]], the youngest daughter of the Echani General [[Yusanis]]]]
*[[Yusanis]] - Echani General, and later senator, who was father of the six [[Handmaiden Sisters]].
*[[Brianna]] - The half-Echani youngest handmaiden in the service of [[Atris]]. She also was a companion of [[Meetra Surik]], the Jedi Exile.
*[[Handmaiden Sisters]] - The five elder sisters of Brianna and daughters of Yusanis.
*[[Raskta Fenni]] - The most skilled Echani duelist of her time.
*[[Raskta Lsu]] - So named for the legendary Raskta Fenni, [[Jedi Weapon Master]] also the most skilled lightsaber duelist of her time.
